reviews.comment: Lectures were really bad and made me more confused than I already was so I stopped attending. She cannot explain her work clearly and would often make mistakes in class. If you didn't take calculus in high school like me, you will have a pretty difficult time in this class.

Sweet lady; but can't teach anyone anything, even if the world depended on it. Can't explain basic concepts, constantly made mistakes, and her teaching style is the equivalent of watching someone do their homework incorrectly. Class average was at the borderline of passing the class (after she heavily curved the final). WIR will be your salvation.

DO NOT take this prof for math 151. The chance of you actually learning in this class is very unlikely. She makes this class way harder than it should be and sometimes she does not even know what she is talking about! She is honestly a nice person but the worst professor I have ever had. Good luck! You will need it!

Caring lady who often makes mistakes during lectures, despite the fact she lectures off of pre-done notes. You better hope your TA is amazing or that you can learn via YouTube. Homework is doable via webassign but your exams are about the only thing that matter. Again nice lady who cares about her students. Good luck!

Don't take if you're new to calc, but if it's your second time- you'll be fine. Not a good lecturer by any means but if you read the book and do tons and tons and tons of practice problems and old common exams, you should do alright. Very sweet but not good at explaining concepts.

As someone who was taking Calc. 1 for the fist time, I was very confused every time I went to lecture. She kind of sped through lectures but people don't realize the amount of material she has to teach so she has to go that fast. I went to the week in reviews and that helped out.

Not a good lecturer but if you read the book and do tons of common exams you'll do alright. Don't go to lecture as it'll probably confuse you more, but take that time to read and do lots of practice problems. The common exams almost never change.

She was a nice lady but a horrible professor, just solved the questions in front of the class and didn't explain what she was doing and why. Wouldnt say the average of the final exam probably because it was so bad. The quizzes are worth 5% of your grade and barely affect the grade and you have one every week along with 2 homework due every week.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures were often hard to follow and had many mistakes.

Lectures aren't really useful even if you pay attention, doesn't explain work clearly at all. Mostly taught myself. Annoying that she cares so much about clicker points and attendance when they didn't help me at all. Class has too much work for the difficulty level of the content.
She's a really nice and caring person but horrible at teaching. Be prepared to teach yourself. Use old released tests and go to A-Plus.

She says iclicker is mandatory, but it really isn't required (isn't weighted into your actual grade).  I didn't go to class after the first two weeks but still managed to do good on the quizzes and tests.  Pretty easy class if you already know calculus.  She did round up my final grade which was borderline to an A which was very nice.

Class is extremely easy if you already know calculus. She seems like a very nice person, however, she is a pretty terrible teacher. She tries to follow her notes from 11 years ago but gets lost and has to get corrected by students all the time. It's best to not go to her class and learn the material yourself.

Dr. Epstein is a really nice lady and clearly cares about her students. Her lectures are hard to follow though, and she tends to just read through her notes. If you were proficient at calculus in high school, this class is pretty easy. Just do the homework and take practice exams.
Sometimes clueless. Caress a lot. But still clueless

Janice Epstein is a kind lady, who truly does care about her class. However she is a very poor lecturer. Math 151 is an easy class if you have taken calculus before. But expect to teach yourself alot of material. The homework is reasonable, and exams are easy to ace if you prepare well. I recommend you avoid Epstein.

Dr. Epstein was not a great professor. She read straight from her notes for the lectures and had trouble answering questions about her work when asked. She also constantly made mistakes while solving example problems. The exams aren't hard, but the homework can be frustrating. Attendance is mandatory. Nice person, but not good for lectures.

Math 140 is so incredibly boring if youve ever been to middle school, but prof Epstein does her best. not her fault that the subject is boring; i took it online, and she did everything to make it engaging and connect with us in an asynchronous environment. i constantly forgot to turn stuff in but still got an A
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took this course only because it was online. Just don't. You have something due 4/7 days of the week, Mandatory office hours, additional assignments that in-person classes aren't required to take. MLC was my saving grace. Tests and weekly quizzes have short time windows. Nice teacher, but high Maintenace course load and requirements for 140

Dr. Epstein is a kind lady who cares about her students' grades but the format of this class makes things a tad complicated. The due dates/times are inconvenient and tests are also kinda over-complicated. It's not the worst math class ever, but it's a pretty big time commitment.

Despite being online, we are required to meet during her office hours. I'm not the best at math but this class was absolutely awful. Her tests are up to 45% of your grade and she will not meet with you ("that's her TA's job"). Just avoid her and her classes overall. Easily one of the worst profs I've ever taken and this is coming from a senior.

Dr. Epstein was AWESOME! Always easily accessible & ready to answer any questions. Notes were clearly outlined with tons of practice problems to help understand concepts. Dr. Epstein made it easy to get an A in math 140. Take her if you can!!

She is such a sweet prof and I highly recommend her. This class was online, but she emailed back quickly and worked with me. She also gave some extra credit on a few assignments. This class was not easy, but with her is was enjoyable and bearable. If you are good at math, this will be an easy class especially with her!
the online class is flexible and works with a heavy schedule, but questions on the home work and quizzes are much harder than anything from the lecture
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. E is accessible to students, responds quickly to emails, and is incredibly fair as far as workload and deadlines. The Math Learning Center and Week In Review sessions are a must for help (and FREE)! Math is not my favorite subject, but her class is not designed to trick you. Watch your lectures, don't procrastinate work, and you will be fine :)
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Due to other ratings, I was nervous, but Dr. Epstein was my favorite professor, class structure wise! The early posted lectures, and weekly to-do lists posted the Saturday before made organizing this class so easy! So much of the work was a completion grade, and there were also extra-credit opportunities! Grateful to finish this class with a 100!

Probably should find a new line or work or maybe just teach elementary math. Very hard to follow class and online formatting of homework/quizzes/tests is atrocious. This shouldn't be a hard class but is unnecessarily made difficult.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Possibly the best math teacher I have ever had. She was always happy to answer questions, the material is well structured, and she gives partial credit on tests. All around awesome prof
If you actually want to learn something and if youre worried about not doing well in a course then please dont even consider her. The format complicates things even more and she is not very helpful
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Epstein cares about her students. That being said, she's a tough teacher, and maybe it was just the format of the class being pre-recorded lectures. I learned very little thru her and everything via her TA.

Don't take her. I consider myself good at math and have never had trouble before, even in higher up math like calculus. I thought it was going to be super easy but I was wrong. She's somewhat accessible but isn't much help. It's a 100% online class but she makes you turn things in in person. Whole class is kind of a mess. Tests are hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Most of my problems with the class does not come from Epstein herself but from the online format. If you struggle in math do not take this class! The online format make your mostly rely on self-learning. The class also seemed way more inconvenient and awkward then it should be. Tests use a program called Examity which was just the worse thing ever.

I took MATH 140 online. Prof Epstein was accessible through email but the TA helped me out a lot more. Lots of homework, but thats pretty expected with online class. Quizzes every Friday. Difficult coursework, but I did pretty well.

Her math 140 class is online and everyone I know is doing terrible because of how difficult she makes the class. Most people take online classes and she makes it so hard with examity and doesnt have due dates at convenient times.
The online class is the worst layout I have ever seen. Beware

Angelina was my TA and she was by far the best ever! The class was a hybrid, but I enjoyed being able to learn, take notes, and complete the homework easily at my own pace. My first test wasn't as good as I hoped bc it was tricky but after the first test I aced the rest! Angelina was always willing to help and wants everyone to succeed, so ask her!

Didn't realize this was a hybrid class until the first day of class. I liked that better because the class was only mandatory 1 day a week just to take a very easy quiz. You have to watch about an hour's worth of videos each week, but the subject matter is very simple and explained thoroughly. Taught by a TA which sucks, but I Dr. Epstein was nice.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This is a hybrid class so it does require you to do extra work outside of scheduled class time. You have to watch multiple videos every week (which aren't that bad if you stay on top of it). 2-3 homeworks due and a quiz at the beginning of each week. The first 3 tests were fairly easy, but the final exam was much more difficult.

I wouldn't even call her a prof. She lives in New York and only comes in for tests. This class was a hybrid and I relied on my TA (who was amazing) to get a good grade. Apparently the prof doesn't even make her own lecture videos. This class has a ton of homework and video lectures. Get ready to do hours of homework and studying. Tests arent bad.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Not a good class if you need someone present to ask questions while learning material. A+ tutoring and the TA are the reason I was successful.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Her TAs do everything and you never get to see the actual prof. Exams are nothing like what we practice in class or from her lectures. And ALL lectures are online since its a hybrid class. Online lectures were useless, confusing, and extremely slow. Homework was useless prep for exams. I did well only cause of 4.0 & Go Tutoring.
Dr. Epstein is not very approachable or friendly. Her class is not very difficult if you have a good TA.

The TAs are what make the class great (Angelina!), but Epstein is a very kind lady who is always eager to help. I personally LOVED taking this class online. It allowed me to go at my own pace and I had the resources I needed to do well. The tests are very straightforward and easy if you've watched the videos, done the homework and attended class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: My TA was Abby and she was awesome. She was always super helpful, but also wouldn't baby you. I never saw Dr. Epstein, but I knew she made the tests and determined our grades. The tests weren't too bad, just be sure to go over topics that you have trouble with, and you should be good to go.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I had Angelina as my TA and she's awesome! She's really the only reason I have a decent grade right now. I've literally only seen the actual prof once which was at the first test. The homework is really easy but the test questions can be tricky but its doable
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Angelina is my TA and she is the sweetest, truly cares about everyone's success, and always makes herself 100% available to help. The tests are unnecessarily hard and tricky. The tests are awful and based on tricks rather than knowing the easy material. 10/10 do not recommend because Epstein couldn't care less if you succeed or not. Just awful.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Epstein does nothing for the course except write the exams, and that is the bane of this course. MATH 141 is not a hard class at all; save yourself the trouble and take a class with another prof in person. Online lectures, homework, and reviews are not made by her. You rely completely on the TA to teach you. Final was very hard.

I took this as a hybrid course and enjoyed it. To make an A you need to make a friend, go to week in reviews and talk to your TA. She does four tests and weekly homework(20 questions max) and about an hour of video lectures. Dr. Epstein is never in Texas but the TAs are helpful and always available. And she replaces the lowest test grad with final
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She does nothing and gets paid for it.  Nice lady if you go talk to her in person though. It's a hybrid course and she lives in New York so you only see her when she flies in for the tests. But the TA's are very helpful.

I took this class as a flipped class, so we met once a week for quizzes in class. It was entirely taught by the TA, mine was super helpful, but you only ever see your professor during exams. She usually is always out of state. There is tons of online homework and lectures so if you're not good at managing your time, you probably shouldn't take this

Horrible! I would not recommend her to anyone. I took the hybrid class, so she didn't really do much, but grade so it's not necessarily her that's bad, just the class and the way it's set up. DO NOT TAKE THIS ONLINE, maybe try her in-class, but not a high recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This is a hybrid class, and unless you have an extremely strong background in math you will have to teach the material to yourself. My TA met with us once a week to do a worksheet and a quiz- it wasn't helpful at all. The tests were extremely tricky, and she was only in town a few days before the test. If you can definitely look at another prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I loathe math but i enjoyed this class. I took the hybrid so it was mostly online and then I just met for my quiz every week. She really cares about her students and replaces your lowest test grade if you get higher on the final and drops lowest hw and quiz grades. If you struggle with math like me, A+'s reviews and her weekly reviews helped!

All of the lectures are online as well as the homework. The in class portion is pretty much just a review and a quiz. You are graded on attendance as well. As nice as it was to only have class once a week it's not worth it considering how much time the outside of class work took. Wouldn't recommend this class unless you are a strong math student.

the format of this class is great if you can organize your time and efforts effectively. The TA's as well as Epstein herself make themselves available as often as possible and are extremely helpful especially when you need to review for a test. I would take this format for every class if I could.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: The once a week meeting is not worth it. She puts up non original videos for teaching and gives quite a bit of homework. The test are unnecessarily difficult for the material-mostly trick questions. She is only around during exam time so there is no real professor for this class. The TAs don't know whats on the test so everything is a bit chaotic.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: You only meet once a week, and everything else was online. Very time consuming but material isn't that difficult. The TA's do their best but I had to teach most of it to myself. Epstein's hybrid class is a great option if you can manage your time well, if not I don't recommend.

I took the hybrid class, and literally only saw her on exam days. All of the in class teaching was done by a scatter brained TA. I really had to work and teach my self things and get help from the ACS tutors when I needed it. It's doable if you can put in the effort, but definitely not an easy class, especially without really having a prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Her homework, test reviews, and video notes do not prepare you for the difficulty of the tests.  She does replace your lowest test grade with final (if it is better) which is a good thing.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Your attendance is mandatory, but she won't step foot in class. Her TAs do all of the teaching for her and she's in fact rarely on campus. Exams are at odd times so that it's hard to remember that you have one coming up. Plenty of online homework, no extra credit.
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. You may like the one day a week lecture but its not worth it.

The MATH141 hybrid class is honestly amazing because you only have to attend class for 1 hour each week and the rest is online. If you have the discipline to actually complete the online lectures & homework, this is a GREAT option. The TA's are great, but you do have to study for Prof Epstein's test because they are not easy by any means

I took the math 141 hybrid class this semester, and I honestly liked it. However, he material isn't easy if you don't watch the video lectures or do your homework. You never Dr. Epstein because we meet once a week with a TA, who was super helpful. She drops your lowest test score and replaces it with the final, and drops lowest quiz and homework.

Half of the class was  online. I spent nearly $300 at tutor john to save myself from this prof and I barely ended up with a B with my best effort. Go to EVERY class for quizzes (they aren't actually hard) and do NOT forget your clicker. Take the notes in class for quizzes but figure out the rest yourself. Don't expect to learn anything in class.
Worst teacher. Her lectures are super confusing you will have to teach yourself all the material so I suggest going to the TA who was actually helpful

where do i start?  she is a tough teacher and the tests are difficult to say the least especially with little to no partial credit. hard to understand during lecture and you have to go to tutoring to really understand the material presented in class.
She goes way too fast, but the TA's and extra sessions can explain all the problems better and slower...

Online Math 141 with Epstein isn't actually that bad.  She can be confusing, but she is not the one narrating the videos anyways.  She drops the lowest grades from each catergory, lecture videos are part of your grade (participation basically), and she gives a lot of extra credit.  If you're decent at math, this class will be pretty easy.

I dropped this class. I do not advise taking this lady, her voice was overtly annoying and her overall teaching methods sucked. Not only that but you basically had to write an entire essay on why you chose a certain answer. Thumbs down all around.

She is probably one of the worst professors I've had. The online homework isn't too bad, but the tests are stupid hard. I went to her office several times and she always treated me like she had better things to do. Definitely not a professor concerned with student welfare.

Her teaching skills definitely need work, the highest grade on the first exam was a 75. Most of the students rely on tutoring in order to learn the material due to her lack of properly explaining the examples. Exams are incredibly hard. Avoid at all costs!!!!!!!

Hard class. Lots of online homework & quizzes every week. Only good thing is that she drops the lowest quiz grades and homework grades. Tests were quite difficult. The way she teaches is hard to follow and understand.

Does not explain HOW to solve a problem, a lot of online homework, a lot of quizzes, test are hard, I hated that class. She seems like a nice lady and she is always willing to answer "questionssssssss???" :)

She is very confusing, her in class lectures are weirdly worded. Her tests are crazy, she is very anal about the free response, you hardly ever get full credit for a question. There is also an insane amount of online work. AVOID IF POSSIBLE!!
The most confusing math teacher you'll ever have. Other teachers teach the same class with much more clarity.

This class was really hard.  Her tests were completely impossible (she had to curve every test), and she doesn't make any sense in class.  Get math tutoring if you take this class.  She is helpful if you go to her office hours.

Besides her extremely annoying voice, the class isnt too bad. If you do the online hw & quizzes, and show up on thursdays for in-class quizzes, you'll be fine. She's willing to help you if you go to her office but in class, she makes no sense. She does expect you to know a lot as well, formulas, ect.

She expects a lot, for you to know every detail and counts off for little things. Gives a lot of notes and sample tests but they are all online so you can print them off. Online quizzes and hw too that help raise your grade.

dude, this lady is horrible... avoid this class! it maybe the subject material, but when you have to curve the final exam like 25 points then you know theres a problem... the only thing that keeps you afloat is the homework
She had a bad teaching style, but she gives a lot of extra credit, and that is what made me get an A in the class.
